SELECT d.id, d.company_id, d.no, d.kind, d.doc_type, d.status, d.version, d.from_warehouse_id, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, d.to_warehouse_id, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, d.partner_id, (SELECT p.short_name FROM sup_supplier p WHERE p.id = d.partner_id) AS partner_name, d.source_no, d.doc_date, d.reason, d.create_by, d.create_time, agg.first_sku_id, agg.item_count, agg.total_qty, agg.total_amount FROM d LEFT JOIN bas_warehouse fw ON fw.id = d.from_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bas_warehouse tw ON tw.id = d.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (array_agg(i.material_sku_id ORDER BY i.seq, i.id))[1] AS first_sku_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(i.qty) AS total_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(i.amount) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(i.amount) ELSE NULL END AS total_amount FROM inv_doc_item i WHERE i.doc_id = d.id) agg ON true
ORDER BY d.create_time, d.id ORDER BY d.id DESC
